verdict.rationale: Perplexity documents an embeddings endpoint for semantic search and RAG pipelines, plus a Search API that returns ranked web results. However, nothing says the Search API itself ranks by meaning rather than keywords, so semantic search over your own data means building your own index from the embeddings. missing for 10: explicit evidence that the Search API ranks semantically, evidence it finds results keyword engines miss, in-depth embeddings documentation, independent or hands-on corroboration of semantic retrieval quality.
